## Synopsis

```text
perch [OPTIONS] COMMAND
```

## Description

perch runs a local IMAP server and authenticated submission endpoint, backed by mxRaven for inbound MX, outbound delivery, SPF/DKIM/DMARC, IP reputation, and spam filtering.

Messages are stored in SQLite or offloaded to S3. The same binary provides administrative commands and a scriptable mail client for IMAP and SMTP.

## Notes

- Run `perch help <command>` or see the per-command manpages for details.
- The default configuration path is `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/perch/perch.yaml`.
- perch does not need a public IP, port forwarding, or inbound SMTP ports.

## Options

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--help, -h` | show help |
| `--version, -v` | print the version |

## Commands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [perch init](perch-init.md) | create a local configuration and optional first account |
| [perch setup](perch-setup.md) | create the mxRaven domain, listeners, keys, and routes |
| [perch serve](perch-serve.md) | run IMAP, submission, and the notification consumer |
| [perch account](perch-account.md) | add, list, password, disable, or enable accounts |
| [perch alias](perch-alias.md) | manage address aliases and catch-all domains |
| [perch mailbox](perch-mailbox.md) | list mailboxes for an account |
| [perch mail](perch-mail.md) | list, search, fetch, and send mail |
| [perch doctor](perch-doctor.md) | check the database, TLS, S3, and mxRaven connectivity |
| [perch backup](perch-backup.md) | write a consistent SQLite backup |
| [perch reconcile](perch-reconcile.md) | force one S3 bucket reconciliation pass |
| [perch gc](perch-gc.md) | remove orphan blobs, old dead letters, and S3 tombstones |
| [perch outbound](perch-outbound.md) | list submitted messages and delivery status |
| [perch version](perch-version.md) | print the version |

## Examples

```sh
perch setup --workspace my-workspace --domain example.com --hostname localhost

perch account add --email you@example.com

perch serve --config ~/.local/share/perch/perch.yaml

perch mail list --server 127.0.0.1:1143 --plaintext --username you@example.com
```
